# KDBindings, vendored

The headers of [KDBindings](https://github.com/KDAB/KDBindings) 1.1.0 (commit efb54c58c3c2fce280d7089617935ec265fe4e2d), unchanged, under the MIT licence (LICENSE.MIT).
`find_package(KDBindings)` is tried first; this copy is used when the system has none, before any download.
